The optional Windows installer uses unmodified NSIS 3.13 runtime/compression code.
Publisher: https://nsis.sourceforge.io/
Source: https://sourceforge.net/projects/nsis/files/NSIS%203/3.13/
The complete publisher copyright and license text is in nsis-COPYING.txt.
Application installer scripts and generated payload manifests are Tomato code;
they do not modify NSIS or its compression modules.

The build-only compiler ZIP is SHA-256 pinned against the publisher dataset:
https://nsis-dev.github.io/release-data/versions.json
